data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Mantesh is derived from the words 'man' (manas) meaning mind and 'tesh' (teshana) meaning desire or wish. It refers to the one who is a divine gift to the world, a manifestation of the Creator's will and love. The name Mantesh carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mantesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
